name: M1 -> U1/U2/L1: the floor is disarmed at the boundary (<=1 becomes <=0), so the last trunk item is fodder again and a card titled 'Rehab + Trunk' prints no trunk
M2 -> CARVE-OUT 2, U4: the long-run guard is deleted, so the floor fires on an NRC long-run day and hands d18LongRunDayPass a section to spend its eight tier B sets on
M3 -> CARVE-OUT 3, U5: the race-window guard is deleted, so the floor fires on race day and on the time trial that IS race day, outranking D37/D38

M4 -> CARVE-OUT 3 half-done, U5: only the literal 'race day' subtype is refused and the time trial is forgotten, which is the V186 S4b mistake (the 5K/10K time trial is race day for every other reader)
M5 -> CARVE-OUT 4, U2: the floor is raised from one item to two, so the budget can no longer take the second trunk piece and a tight day keeps volume D48 never asked for

M6 -> CARVE-OUT 1, U3: the predicate is rewritten to count SECTION LABELS instead of items, which is the level error D50 exists to correct — it protects a two-item section that is not at the floor and misses a relocated single item
M7 -> U1/L1: the taxonomy is narrowed to the anti-rotation label alone, so the anti-extension section is invisible to the floor and a day can still land on zero trunk
M8 -> G3b (gear gates): the core finisher draw is capped at zero members, so a block prints with no items at all — the bar D48 actually set, now that G3b asserts zero instead of a pair
